ourStory.title: Our story
ourStory.intro: Born in 2010 on the Belgian Plateau, Gazmatek is a self-managed collective built around sound, stage design and emerging artists. Crew, label and our own sound system — every euro is reinvested into production, gear and artists.
ourStory.mission: Our mission hasn't changed: put emerging talent on stage with uncompromising standards on sound, stage design and reliability — from the first call to the post-event debrief.

pricingGrid.title: No opaque pricing — here's our formula
pricingGrid.subtitle: An artist fee depends on their tier (L1 → L4) and the venue capacity. Multiply by the ticket price and you get the bracket.
pricingGrid.example: Example: a L3 in a 1,000-cap venue at €20 → 40 × 20 = €800 recommended fee.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions we hear most often.

q1.q: How fast do you get back to me?
q1.a: Within 24 business hours on average. Short-notice events (< 14 days) are treated in priority.

q2.a: All of Belgium by default. Neighbouring countries (France, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Germany) on a per-quote basis.

q3.a: 30% deposit on confirmation, balance 48h before the event at the latest.

q4.q: What if we need to cancel?
q4.a: Conditions are detailed in the booking contract: full refund up to 30 days before, degressive afterwards. We stay flexible in case of force majeure.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms of use govern your access to and use of the Gazmatek website and online booking services. By browsing the site or submitting a booking request, you agree to be bound by them.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
paragraphs: Gazmatek is an artist booking agency that represents DJs, live acts and performers and connects them with event organisers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

The website lets you discover our roster, estimate a budget through the price simulator and submit a booking request. Submitting a request does not constitute a confirmed booking: every request is reviewed and confirmed by our team before any contract takes effect.

sections.title: 2. Bookings and quotes
paragraphs: Prices displayed by the simulator are indicative and non-contractual. The final fee depends on the artist, the date, the venue capacity, the ticket price and the requested format, and is confirmed in writing after our team reviews your request.
A booking is only firm once you have received written confirmation, paid the agreed deposit and, where applicable, signed the engagement contract.

sections.title: 3. Accounts
paragraphs: Some features require an account. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential and for all activity carried out under your account.
You agree to provide accurate information and to keep it up to date, in particular the contact and billing details used for your bookings.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
paragraphs: You agree not to misuse the site, attempt to disrupt its operation, access it through unauthorised means, or use it for any unlawful purpose.
You may not reproduce or exploit the content of the site, including artist profiles, photos and biographies, without our prior written consent.

sections.title: 5. Intellectual property
paragraphs: All content published on the site — trademarks, logos, texts, photographs and visuals — is protected and remains the property of Gazmatek or its partners and artists. No licence or right of use is granted beyond browsing the site.

sections.title: 6. Liability
paragraphs: We do our best to keep information accurate and the service available, but we cannot guarantee that the site will be free of errors or interruptions.
Gazmatek cannot be held liable for indirect damages arising from the use of the site, except in cases of gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

sections.title: 7. Contact
paragraphs: For any question about these terms, you can reach us at contact@gazmatek.com.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Gazmatek collects, uses and protects your personal data when you use our website and booking services, in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: Gazmatek acts as the data controller for the personal data collected through this site. For any privacy-related request, contact us at contact@gazmatek.com.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: Account and contact details: name, email address, phone number and, where relevant, company and billing information.
Booking details: event date, location, capacity, format and any context you share with your request.
Technical data: information collected through cookies and similar technologies to keep the site secure and measure its usage.

sections.title: 3. How we use your data
paragraphs: To process and confirm your booking requests and manage the related contracts and payments.
To communicate with you about your account, your bookings and our services.
To operate, secure and improve the website and, where you have consented, to measure its audience.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
paragraphs: We process your data to perform the contract or pre-contractual steps you request, to comply with our legal obligations, on the basis of our legitimate interest in running the agency, and on your consent where required (for example for non-essential cookies).

sections.title: 5. Sharing and retention
paragraphs: Your data may be shared with the artists involved in your booking and with the service providers that help us operate (hosting, payment, electronic signature, email). We never sell your data.
We keep your data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described above and to meet our legal and accounting obligations.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to restrict or object to its processing, and to data portability. You may also withdraw your consent at any time.
To exercise these rights, contact us at contact@gazmatek.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority.

sections.title: 7. Cookies
paragraphs: We use strictly necessary cookies to operate the site and, subject to your consent, analytics and marketing cookies. You can review and change your choices at any time through the cookie preferences available on the site.
